compatibilityReview.reviewer: DOC-032 independent walkthrough, compatibility and bridge reviewer agents (one seat per article group or set, independent of the source-review authors)
compatibilityReview.summary: DOC-032 (#1194) re-verified the suite for the 0.1.0 release candidate ad345da5. A triage agent mapped the app diff from 067c1646 to 4ca41822 against every guide. 26 guides got a source review and an independent agent walkthrough on labs built from 4ca41822, and 31 carried a compatibility review that replayed their DOC-030 scripts there. A bridge reviewer then read the diff from 4ca41822 to ad345da5 (comments, version strings, nodemailer and sharp patch releases, message catalog) and replayed every check it can reach on labs built from ad345da5. install, upgrade and versions-and-support were walked again on ad345da5. 57 of 62 guides pass. electronic-signing and configure-signing wait for a live DocuSign session (#1178), connect-claude for a live claude.ai session after its M42 changes, and connect-chatgpt and connect-microsoft-365-copilot for DOC-031 (#1187). None of the five receives credit.

publication.reason: User decision in DOC-030 (#1157), 2026-09-26: "Keep them, open DOC-031", on the option that connect-chatgpt and connect-microsoft-365-copilot stay in Help with an unverified badge until live ChatGPT and Copilot sessions under DOC-031 (#1187). This authorizes availability with validation in progress, not a claim that verification has passed.
